title: 第940章 玉佩退强敌安若惜解疑第939章 抵达落星城无端被攻击
lines: “什么，客栈主人竟然退了？！”
本以为这新来的小子会遭受到惩罚，结果醉仙楼的主人却先退缩了。
众人不由得将目光看向了楚峰手中的玉佩。
但楚峰却早已将其收了起来。
不过，还是有人感知到了玉佩上散发出的气息。
那是道台境强者才有的。
“嘶，这小子不仅有灵火，背后还有道台境强者做靠山，定然是一流宗门的弟子！”
仅仅只是一枚玉佩，便替楚峰化解了惊天危机。
这便是一流宗门才有的威慑力。
这时，那原本淹没光头三人的白色火龙被楚峰收回。
众人不由得看了过去，当他们看清光头三人的状态时，顿时倒吸一口凉气。
只见原本还意气风发的三人，此刻无比的狼狈。
瘦子和胖子气喘吁吁，身上的衣服早就烧成了灰烬。
不少皮肤上都有严重的烧伤。
光头男子就更加惨了，此刻昏迷倒地，不省人事。
胖子和瘦子拿出丹药给光头服下，随即带着他匆忙地上了楼。
楚峰瞥了一眼三人的背影，并没有再出手。
这三人能活下，的确有些出乎了他的预料。
但这里毕竟是落星城，是别人的地盘，还是低调一些为好。
看着光头三人狼狈离开的样子，一楼大厅内的武者都不由得摇了摇头。
这光头三人在落星城一带，可不是什么阿猫阿狗的小角色。
三人联手在落日平原中探险，早已闯出不小的名气。
手中的保命底牌自然不会少，而此刻，却差点死在了这忽然出现的年轻人手中。
的确是令人唏嘘不已。
众人看向楚峰的眼神彻底变了，已经不再像刚才那样轻视了。
“这小子不可招惹！”
众人心中默默想着。
他没理会众人，转身找了张空桌坐下，叫了一壶醉仙酿，兀自喝了起来。
与此同时，醉仙楼顶楼，三位老者正围坐在八仙桌旁。
桌子上同样有着一壶醉仙酿，但相比于一楼的，品质明显高上一截。
“老莫，这小家伙貌似来历不凡啊！”
content_en:
"What, the inn owner actually backed out?!"
I thought that the new boy would be punished, but the owner of Zuixian Tower backed down first.
Everyone couldn't help but look at the jade pendant in Chu Feng's hand.
But Chu Feng had already put it away.
However, some people still sensed the aura emanating from the jade pendant.
That is only available to those who are strong in the Taoist realm.
"Hiss, this kid not only has spiritual fire, but also has a strong Taoist realm as his backer. He must be a disciple of a first-rate sect!"
Just a jade pendant helped Chu Feng resolve a shocking crisis.
This is the deterrent power that only a first-class sect can have.
At this time, the white fire dragon that originally drowned the bald trio was taken back by Chu Feng.
Everyone couldn't help but look over, and when they saw the state of the three bald men clearly, they suddenly took a breath of cold air.
I saw that the three people who were still high-spirited at first were extremely embarrassed at this moment.
The thin man and the fat man were panting, and their clothes had long been burned to ashes.
Many of the skins had severe burns.
The bald man was even more miserable. At this moment, he fell to the ground unconscious.
The fat man and the thin man took out the elixir and gave it to the bald man, then took him upstairs in a hurry.
Chu Feng glanced at the backs of the three people and did not take action again.
The survival of these three people was indeed beyond his expectation.
But this is Falling Star City after all, it is someone else’s territory, so it’s better to keep a low profile.
Seeing the bald trio leaving in embarrassment, the warriors in the hall on the first floor couldn't help but shake their heads.
These bald three people are not just a small role in the Falling Star City area.
The three of them joined forces to explore the Sunset Plains and had already become quite famous.
Naturally, he had many life-saving cards in his hand, but at this moment, he almost died in the hands of this young man who suddenly appeared.
It's really sad.
The way everyone looked at Chu Feng completely changed, and they were no longer as contemptuous as before.
"Don't mess with this kid!"
Everyone was thinking silently in their hearts.
He ignored everyone, turned around, found an empty table, sat down, ordered a pot of Drunken Immortal Brew, and drank it by himself.
At the same time, on the top floor of Zuixian Tower, three old men were sitting around the Eight Immortals table.
There is also a pot of Drunken Immortal Brew on the table, but compared to the one on the first floor, the quality is obviously higher.
"Old Mo, this little guy seems to have an extraordinary origin!"
title_en: Chapter 940 Jade Pendant retreats from the powerful enemy An Ruoxi solves the mystery Chapter 939 Arrives at Luo Xing City and is attacked for no reason
